The '''''Nomme''''' was a [[Container transport]] under the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Following [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] [[Battle of Ottega|unsuccessful]] [[Battle of Imperial Center|coup]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Zaarin sent his [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] to the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]] to destroy the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] starfighter manufacturing plants starting with the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|Manufacturing facilities]] [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|Omar]] [[Omar 1|1]], [[Omar 2|2]] and [[Omar 3|3]]. Unable to send a large fleet in time loyalist forces instead sent transports to evacuate as much personal as possible. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] the Empire's most reliable pilot was sent to hold of Zaarin's forces which consisted of ''TIE Advanced'', the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|Modified Frigate]] [[Raptor (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|Raptor]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]]. ''Nomme'' managed to board ''Omar 2'' and evacuated most, but not all, of the personnel and escaped the battle into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
